intro.headline: Last step: the role you'll play to get there.
intro.body: Every great team runs on three kinds of talent: the Commander 帅才 who sets direction, the General 将才 who delivers results, and the Chancellor 相才 who builds what lasts. Six quick scenarios. Choose what feels most like you.
intro.story:
Over 2,000 years ago, the founder of the Han dynasty explained his victory simply. He could not out-plan his strategist, out-govern his chancellor or out-fight his general. But he knew how to bring all three together. 吾能用之，此吾所以取天下也。

Today, every company, project and career still runs on the same Iron Triangle 铁三角.

roles.name: Commander
roles.subtitle: Visionary Leader
roles.essence: 帅才 · 定方向 · 谋全局 · 聚人心
roles.oneLine: Sets direction, sees the whole board and unites people behind a goal.
roles.exemplarLine: He admitted he was not the best strategist, administrator or general, but he could lead all three.
roles.coreLine: You see where things should go and help others commit to getting there.
roles.contribution: You give a team a “why” and a direction worth following.
roles.watchOut: You may underestimate the detail and follow-through ideas need, or move on before they are executed.
roles.allies: A General to turn direction into results, and a Chancellor to make it sustainable.
roles.thrive: 1 → 10 growth stages: leading a team, function, venture or strategic initiative.
roles.growthEdge: Pair every vision with one concrete first step and one clear owner.

roles.name: General
roles.subtitle: Breakthrough Achiever
roles.essence: 将才 · 攻坚破局 · 执行落地
roles.oneLine: Breaks through obstacles, executes under pressure and delivers results.
roles.exemplarLine: Commanded vast armies and “won every battle, took every city”.
roles.coreLine: You turn goals into wins and move first when it matters.
roles.contribution: You create momentum and measurable results.
roles.watchOut: You may take on too much personally, skip systems, or burn out.
roles.allies: A Commander to give you a battle worth winning, and a Chancellor to secure the gains.
roles.thrive: 0 → 1 stages: frontline, sales, business development, launches, turnarounds.
roles.growthEdge: Before charging, confirm the direction. After winning, capture what worked as a repeatable method.

roles.name: Chancellor
roles.subtitle: Steady Architect
roles.essence: 相才 · 固本赋能 · 运筹帷幄
roles.oneLine: Builds the systems, resources and stability that make success last.
roles.exemplarLine: Kept the state stable, the people cared for and supply lines unbroken.
roles.coreLine: You make things run well, and you make them last.
roles.contribution: You create stability, so growth doesn't collapse under its own weight.
roles.watchOut: You may over-prepare, resist fast change, or go unnoticed because good systems are invisible.
roles.allies: A Commander to set direction, and a General to create momentum.
roles.thrive: 10 → 100 scale stages: operations, finance, HR, compliance, programme management, advisory.
roles.growthEdge: Make your impact visible. Quantify the risk you prevented and the time you saved.

scenarios.prompt: A new project lands on your team with no clear plan. What do you naturally do first?

options.commander: Define what success looks like and why it matters, then set the direction.
options.general: Get moving: take on the hardest piece and start producing results.
options.chancellor: Map out roles, resources, timeline and risks so nothing falls through.

scenarios.prompt: Your team is behind on an important deadline. You…

options.commander: Re-prioritise: decide what truly matters and rally everyone around it.
options.general: Roll up your sleeves and personally push the critical tasks over the line.
options.chancellor: Find the bottleneck in the process and fix it so it doesn't happen again.

scenarios.prompt: Which recognition feels most meaningful to you?

options.commander: “You saw where we needed to go before anyone else.”

scenarios.prompt: When facing a major decision, you focus first on…

options.commander: The long-term picture and where it positions you in 3–5 years.
options.general: What will create the fastest measurable progress now.
options.chancellor: The risks, resources and whether it is sustainable.

scenarios.prompt: In a team, people usually rely on you to…

options.commander: Set the vision and make the big calls.
options.general: Win the difficult battles: close the deal, solve the crisis, hit the target.
options.chancellor: Keep people, money and processes in good order.

scenarios.prompt: What frustrates you most at work?

options.commander: No clear direction: everyone busy but going nowhere.
options.general: Endless planning and meetings with no action.

reveal.headline: Your Iron Triangle Role
reveal.shareTooltip: Talent Tree scores are independent strengths: you can be strong at everything. The Iron Triangle shows how your natural contribution is distributed across the three roles, so it is displayed as a share of 100%.

commander.classicImbalance: 有将相，无帅才: busy and orderly, but without direction
commander.insight: You may sometimes work hard on things that aren't clearly moving you forward. Seek mentors or leaders with clear vision, and set your own 12-month direction.

general.classicImbalance: 有帅相，无将才: strong plans, slow results
general.insight: Your ideas and systems may be ahead of your results. Work with doers, set short deadlines and celebrate small wins.

chancellor.classicImbalance: 有帅将，无相才: fast growth, fragile foundations
chancellor.insight: You may create momentum faster than structure. Build simple systems, and partner with someone who loves stability and detail.

commander_general.label: The Pioneer
commander_general.line: You set the direction and lead the charge yourself.

commander_chancellor.label: The Architect-Leader
commander_chancellor.line: You set the direction and build the structure to carry it.

general_chancellor.label: The Operator
general_chancellor.line: You deliver results and make them repeatable.

balanced.label: 三才兼备 · The Complete Triangle
balanced.line: You flex across all three roles. Watch-out: you may be pulled in every direction, so choose a primary lane for this season.

lines: Where talent, purpose and role meet
